主要内容: On August 5, 2013, Richard G. Rawson, President of Insperity, Inc., established new structured, prearranged trading plans to sell a portion of his common shares over a nine month period in accordance with Rule 10b5-1 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The plans allow him to sell a maximum of 66,440 shares, representing approximately 9% of his current holdings. The transactions were initiated during the company's open window for insider trading. Rule 10b5-1 permits insiders to implement written plans for selling stock at times when they are not in possession of material nonpublic information, enabling regular, non-discretionary sales regardless of subsequent information received.
